entities.name: Sextus Vettulenus Cerialis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sextus Vettulenus Cerialis was a Roman senator and military commander, the 1st legate of Judaea. He was an early supporter of Vespasian, who appointed Cerialis suffect consul in either 72 or 73.
